text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe the rhythm's a bit off? It's 
harder than I thought.
choice_data_list: Looks like you're having a tough battle.
Looks like you're having a tough battle.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, while I've had plenty of 
opportunities to dance before, it was 
always ballroom dancing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But you know, it's fun! Learning new 
things is always super exciting♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even the choreography I couldn't do at 
first, look, just like this!

Fine Motion speaks of it lightly, but it 
couldn't have been easy. She must have put 
in immense effort behind the scenes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. At this rate, I'll master it in no 
time~!
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to the day I get to 
see you dance.

How about adding a little of what makes 
you *you*, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Once I've mastered the dance, 
Trainer, you'll be the very first one I 
show it to♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
After that, I'm going to take a video of 
myself dancing and show it to everyone in 
my family!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I hope everyone enjoys watching me dance 
styles other than ballroom dancing~!

Fine Motion dancing so innocently looked 
just like a fairy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm? What do you mean by that?
choice_data_list:
Maybe incorporate some ballroom dance 
choreography?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, that sounds great! It really feels 
like a cultural exchange, how wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then, during the interlude, I'll gently 
sway...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah! This fits the song's vibe perfectly♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice, Trainer. Look 
forward to my dance!

A dance that only Fine Motion could 
perform— I found myself eagerly looking 
forward to its completion.
